description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ What's new
- Add support for Volume Attachment, which was also added to Cluster Overview
- Added Volume Attachment to Cluster Overview
- Resource Tabs (Overview/YAML/Events, etc) are now also part of tab history so it works as expected with Back/Forward features
- Add setting to restore previous behaviour of showing context selector on launch #573
🐞 Bugs Fixed
- fix filter bug on Workloads/Cluter Overview Discord
